item.title: Common yarrow (*Achillea millefolium*)
item.description: Yarrow is a highly versatile perennial, particularly valuable for relieving menstrual cramps, digestive issues, colds, fevers, and for healing wounds.

item.title: Milk thistle (*Silybum marianum*)
item.description: Milk thistle (Silybum marianum) is an impressive prickly plant whose fruits contain silymarin—a complex of active compounds widely researched for its potential protective effects on the liver. Some clinical studies also show promising results for fatty liver disease and type 2 diabetes, though current evidence remains limited and mixed.
